mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing this fact removes the constraint that a Permitted clinical-endpoint outcome requires an active care-team membership. The injected violation forces a Permitted RecordsLookup operation with no matching ActiveMembership, which both OwnershipBasedAccess and FR_004_CareTeamGating check for.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_CareTeamViolation { some op: Operation | op.opKind = RecordsLookup and op.opOutcome = Permitted and (no m: ActiveMembership | m.member = op.opCaller and m.memberPatient = op.opPatient) }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing this fact allows two distinct Operations to share a single AuditEntry atom, simulating an audit-log entry being 'overwritten' or 'reused'. The injection forces exactly this sharing, which AppendOnly and FR_014_AuditImmutable directly check.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AuditInjectiveViolation { some disj op1, op2: Operation | op1.opAudit = op2.opAudit }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing this fact removes the structural constraint that clinical notes must be authored by clinical-role users. The injection forces a ClinicalNote authored by a HospitalAdministrator, violating both FR_005_AdminContentBlindness and FR_010_NoteAuthorClinical.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AdminAuthorViolation { some n: ClinicalNote | n.noteAuthor.userRole = HospitalAdministrator }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing this fact removes the biconditional that auditNote is set iff the access type is AddNote and the outcome is Permitted. The injection forces an AuditEntry with accessType=Read to carry a non-null auditNote, directly violating FR_013_AuditNoteIdConsistency.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AuditNoteIdViolation { some ae: AuditEntry | ae.auditAccessType = Read and one ae.auditNote }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing this fact allows a non-administrator (e.g., a Doctor) to appear as the caller of an AuditSearch Operation. The injection forces this, violating both FR_017_AuditSearchAdminOnly and NoInformationLeakage (which requires that clinical callers never reach the AuditSearch handler).
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AuditSearchRoleViolation { some op: Operation | op.opKind = AuditSearch and op.opCaller.userRole = Doctor }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing this fact allows an AuditEntry's auditUser to differ from the Operation's opCaller, simulating misattribution. The injection forces an operation whose audit entry records a different user, violating both AttributionCorrectness and FR_013_AttributionIntegrity.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AttributionViolation { some op: Operation | some u: User | u != op.opCaller and op.opAudit.auditUser = u }
